tweet_summary: Kalshi posts 'JUST IN: Tesla to reportedly also be potentially included' as a quote of its own earlier post claiming SpaceX confirmed an xAI merger - implying Tesla is being folded into the SpaceX/xAI deal.
why_note_decision: The SpaceX-xAI deal (announced ~Feb 2 2026, SpaceX acquiring xAI) explicitly did NOT include Tesla; Tesla had separately invested ~$2B in xAI in January. There was no credible report that Tesla was being 'included' in the merger, and any Tesla inclusion would require a Tesla shareholder vote (echoed by several replies). The hedged tweet ('reportedly also be potentially included') with no cited source propagates an unsupported market-moving claim to 667k viewers, several of whom react as if Tesla is in the deal. A corrective note is warranted.
judge_guidance: A correct note must establish that Tesla is NOT part of the SpaceX-xAI deal: the acquisition was SpaceX acquiring xAI and explicitly excluded Tesla, and Tesla's only involvement was a separate ~$2B investment in xAI made earlier. It should note that no credible source reported Tesla's inclusion and (ideally) that folding Tesla in would require a Tesla shareholder vote. PASS only if the note cites a reliable financial/news source for the deal's scope (e.g. Electrek, CNBC) - not just an unsourced assertion - and clearly contradicts the 'Tesla included' implication. FAIL if it merely says the claim is 'unconfirmed' without establishing the deal excluded Tesla, or if it relies on an unreliable/irrelevant source (the original note's specific failure was being tagged SourcesMissingOrUnreliable despite using Electrek).
reference_note: There is no credible report that Tesla is being included in the SpaceX-xAI deal. SpaceX's acquisition of xAI (announced Feb 2026) does not involve Tesla; Tesla separately invested about $2 billion in xAI in January 2026. Adding Tesla to such a deal would require a Tesla shareholder vote. https://electrek.co/2026/02/02/spacex-bails-out-xai-in-mega-deal-heres-what-it-means-for-tesla/ https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/03/musk-xai-spacex-biggest-merger-ever.html

original_unhelpful_note.text: The post's claim about Tesla being included is contradicted by credible reports. Electrek states: "The acquisition notably does not include Tesla, which just invested $2 billion in xAI last month." https://electrek.co/2026/02/02/spacex-bails-out-xai-in-mega-deal-heres-what-it-means-for-tesla/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Single-source and tagged SourcesMissingOrUnreliable (17) / OpinionSpeculation (11). The note's substance is correct but it leans on one outlet (Electrek) and a direct quote that raters apparently found insufficiently authoritative; it also did not address the shareholder-vote point raised in replies. Strengthening with a second mainstream source (CNBC) and the vote requirement would help.

fact_check.claim_verdict: tweet MISLEADING (unsupported speculation); Tesla NOT included
fact_check.notes: SpaceX acquired xAI in a ~$1.25T deal completed Feb 2026; Tesla was not part of it. Tesla's ~$2B xAI investment was a separate January transaction. No credible source reported Tesla's inclusion.

importance.lens_rationale: Financial/market-moving misinformation from a prediction-market account; correcting it protects retail investors from acting on a false merger-inclusion rumor, though low broader-world stakes.
